summary: Small open observation tower on Monroe Hill in Fox State Research Forest, Hillsborough NH; one hiking guide dates it to 1934; still standing.

facts.design: Small open observation tower (FFLA type: Open Tower)

access.note: Reached on foot from a trailhead on Center Road in Hillsborough; no closure notice found

visit.trail_note: Old road then Ridge Trail from Center Road; steep in places; about a quarter mile to the tower (NH Family Hikes)

events.note: Date from NH Family Hikes only; state record not checked

evidence.supports: small observation tower in the northern section of Fox State Research Forest
evidence.quote: This short hike leads to a small observation tower in the northern section of Fox State Research Forest.

evidence.supports: built 1934 and used to watch over the forest
evidence.quote: The historic tower was originally built in 1934 and was used to watch over the forest.

evidence.supports: speculated to have been a backup fire lookout
evidence.quote: It was also speculated to have been a backup fire lookout.

evidence.supports: current tower may or may not be built around the original
evidence.quote: The current tower that stands today may or may not be built around the original tower.

evidence.supports: tower is on the side of Monroe Hill
evidence.quote: It is located on the side of Monroe Hill

evidence.supports: trailhead is on Center Road in Hillsborough
evidence.quote: Trailhead is on Center Road in Hillsborough, NH.

evidence.supports: route follows an overgrown, grassy road for 0.1 miles
trail then turns onto Ridge Trail
evidence.quote: Then turn right onto Ridge Trail, a footpath.
The way is steep at times and passes some boulders.

evidence.supports: tower about a quarter mile up the trail
evidence.quote: In a quarter mile, the trail levels off and reaches the small observation tower.

evidence.supports: visitors can climb the stairs for a view through the trees
evidence.quote: Climb the stairs to look through a tiny opening in the trees into the distance.

evidence.supports: fire tower history lists Monroe Hill south peak in Hillsborough at 1,170 feet
FFLA lists the site as an Open Tower, standing, in Hillsborough County
FFLA files the site in a section for lookout sites and non-lookout structures
2023 visitor called it a very small outlook tower
evidence.quote: is a very small outlook tower

evidence.supports: blog post dated April 2023 (the hike write-up)
views come in glimpses as the trees have grown
evidence.quote: Peakaboo views from the tower as the trees have grown

evidence.supports: one forum poster who visited is unsure whether the list means the tower or the hilltop
evidence.quote: the view tower seems to be the
the coordinates agree with the hilltop

corrections.why: FFLA lists the site as an Open Tower, and NH Family Hikes and the 2023 visitor describe a small observation or outlook tower

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The list's coordinates match the hilltop, while one forum poster who visited is unsure whether the listed Monroe Hill point means the tower or the high point. We describe the tower on the hill.

sources.title: Fox State Forest/ Monroe Hill Tower - Part 6
NH Firetower's List Question- Monroe Hill, Fox Forest, Hillsborough
sources.publisher: New England & New York Backcountry & Hiking Forum

notes_for_editor: The 1934 date rests on NH Family Hikes alone (AllTrails repeats it, unread). NHDFL pages and PDF returned 403 to fetch_text and WebFetch, and Living New Deal returned 403, so the state record is unchecked. The record's kind 'platform' conflicts with FFLA's 'Open Tower'. FFLA files the site under non-lookout structures. Current stair condition and closure status are not verified.
